spec.behavior: Render 1200 frames of a 2D game scene on a 320x200 RGBA8 software canvas and print the frame, tile, sprite and glyph counts. Each frame clears to (16,20,32,255); draws the visible tiles of a scrolling 21x12 map of opaque 15x15 tiles; draws 48 moving 12x12 sprites at alpha 180; draws a 320x12 HUD bar at alpha 160; and draws two lines of 5x7 bitmap-font text, a white HUD line at scale 1 and a gold title at scale 2 and alpha 200.
spec.canvas: 320x200 RGBA8, premultiplied as core.ui's canvas is, row-major, cleared by an opaque full-canvas replace each frame
spec.text: "SCORE {(f * 7) % 100000} FRAME {f}" at (4, 2) size 10 in white; "JET RASTER" at (196, 176) size 20 in (255,220,120,200). Scale is max((size + 5) / 10, 1), advance 6 * scale; each glyph column draws one rectangle per vertical run of set bits of the 95-glyph 5x7 font
spec.blend: core.ui's one blend rule: every rectangle clips to the canvas; a color premultiplies on entry, each of red, green and blue (c * a + 127) / 255; opaque colors copy; alpha 0 skips; otherwise every channel, alpha included, becomes s + (d * (255 - a) + 127) / 255 with s the premultiplied source byte (a for alpha)
spec.capture: with JET_FRAME_CAPTURE set, the frame is written to that path as a P7 RGB_ALPHA PAM (the Jet rail writes the final frame once, the other rails every presented frame); all six rails leave the same final-frame bytes

jet.author: NativeRaylib-1
jet.notes: Draws through the core.ui software rasterizer on a headless window (ui.headless, clear_background, draw_rectangle on each Frame, load_image_from_screen for the capture); no foreign code. core.ui's draw_text draws anti-aliased Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, so the rail carries the 5x7 font and draws each glyph column's vertical runs with draw_rectangle, as the other rails do. The headless window also records an FNV-1a checksum of every frame, which the hand-written rails do not.

rust.author: NativeRaylib-1
rust.notes: Std-only rasterizer over a Vec<u8> canvas with the same clip, blend, font and vertical glyph runs; capture via std::env::var_os.

python.author: NativeRaylib-1
python.notes: Pure Python over a bytearray canvas: opaque fills use slice assignment, translucent fills use per-(source, alpha) bytes.translate tables over strided channel slices. NumPy is not available in the host toolchain.

c.author: NativeRaylib-1
c.notes: Libc-only rasterizer over a static uint8_t canvas. The matched peer is a hand-written C rasterizer with the same algorithm: GPU-backed C game libraries have no headless software path.

zig.author: NativeRaylib-1
zig.notes: Std-only rasterizer over a static [256000]u8 canvas; capture via init.environ_map and std.Io.Dir.createFile.

node.author: NativeRaylib-1
node.notes: Built-in Node rasterizer over a Uint8Array canvas; capture via fs.writeFileSync.
